title: Broadcast channel Freely IP
product-requirement: Return correct information about the current broadcast channel for Freely IP.
specification: Terminals MUST implement the video/broadcast embedded object as defined in clause 7.13.1 of OIPF Declarative Application Environment, hereafter OIPF DAE, and as profiled and extended in clause A.2.4 of TS 102 796.
assertion: The Broadcast channel returns the expected current channel properties for Freely IP.
